# A06-S14: Model policy

Extract from the operator’s source text. Omitted passages are marked […].

[…]

This is really exciting... I had a hunch that it might be hard for the 
 American tech company to understand the difference between an artistic and a 
 political party. They forbid 'political campaigns', and we are not that— 
 it's an artistic, apolitical campaign. But now they read the content, and we 
 get our first review :-D

If they block it, then they have violated artistic freedom and we 
 have a media case. Additionally, one can make a lot of good satire by renaming the 
 project to “The Synthetic (formerly The Synthetic Party” and really 
 fight for democratic rights and Big Tech as an obstacle for 
 Life with Artificials.

And if they really become difficult, then I will just move the platform over to 
 EleutherAI’s open source model.

[…]
